text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making sex discrimination virtually impossible to substantiate. An all-female panel selecting one female candidate over another offers no evidence of gender bias. Raising the panel's gender composition would likely be viewed as baseless and could undermine your professional standing within the civil service.

The appointment likely came down to specific qualifications—such as the selected candidate's international project leadership—or interview performance. Rather than focusing on the panel’s demographics, send a polite follow-up requesting written feedback, framing your inquiry constructively around your ongoing career development and future promotion opportunities.
